comments.text: From audit prompt gist: 'Command execution — shelling out where args are built by concatenation rather than passed as a list.' We detect System.cmd/:os.cmd but don't flag when the args list is built via string concatenation (e.g., System.cmd("git", ["diff", "--\#{path}"])). The extractor should detect <> operator inside cmd arg construction and flag it as higher risk than list-based args. Severity: High.

title: Elixir: detect Shell.escape/1 bypass and string concatenation in shell args
